sloka: शंशन्ति इव हि मे देवीम् भक्षिताम् रजनीचरैः ।हा मम आर्ये क्व याता असि हा साध्वि वर वर्णिनि ॥३-६२-९॥
transliteration: śaṁśanti iva hi me devīm bhakṣitām rajanīcaraiḥ ।hā mama ārye kva yātā asi hā sādhvi vara varṇini ॥3-62-9॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, these herds of deer with their eyes filled with tears are as if telling me that she is eaten away by the demons.
